digest.component_or_area: rebar lifecycle verification and policy enforcement
propositions: Both verify.enforce_plan_material_pins and verify.require_plan_review_for_close must be enabled in rebar.toml while library defaults remain disabled.
Legacy unpinned attestations and current pinned targets with valid execution reviews must pass both enforcement gates without requiring data migration or backfill.
Stale material-pin drift must reject claim/close operations with exit 1, leave status unchanged, and identify the canonical stale target with reason tokens including stale-pin-drift.
Plan-review enforcement must reject close transitions lacking a compatible execution-phase review with exit 1, remain in_progress, and instruct operator to run review-plan.
Natural transitive invalidation must occur only after actual narrow material changes, and unchanged successful re-review must produce no downstream propagation.
Depends_on and blocks references to one canonical prerequisite must normalize to a single prerequisite pin/evaluation.
